reuse.why: All five month-wide actions, including the new one, go through the existing getBulkBudgetCategories and averageToBudget, but the #fixed check hand-rolls a case-insensitive regex instead of using the tree's tag parsing in shared/tags.ts (extractTagsFromText), and saved-template detection re-parses goal_def locally.

duplication.why: Exclusion rules are added once in the shared selection; the only duplicated logic is the ad hoc tag matcher, which re-implements the notes-tag grammar with different case rules.

placement.why: Category selection rules live in the single bulk-selection helper in budget/actions.ts and the new method is registered alongside its siblings in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps, though getBudgetData's SELECT gains a goal_def column that nothing uses.

maintainability.why: One place decides which categories bulk actions touch and the flag is a clear rename of the old includeHidden; the private tag regex can drift from tag semantics elsewhere.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts FIXED_TAG regex goes around shared/tags.ts tag extraction (extractTagsFromText) for reading tags from notes.

disguised_duplication.where: The tag matcher is an independent reimplementation rather than a disguised copy; no other logic is duplicated.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories: includeHidden renamed to includeHiddenCategories (no net new parameter; setZero's includeHidden=true special case removed); template and #fixed exclusions are general rules for all callers; all five bulk actions, including setLastMonthSpending, call the helper.
